name: place-at-mouse
description: Aiming and clicking places a Mine centered on the pointer, and the ghost counts Ore fields in its work area. Mouse-to-anchor mapping and the range count are presentation.

steps.comment: A 2x2 Mine centered on the grid corner (21, 21) is anchored at (20, 20).
Map cell (6, 5) spans x 24..28, 3 units from the Mine's center.
